messages:
Marco (Partnerships): Hey team — quick coordination thread for the co-hosted session at EdgeWorks on 2026-04-12 11:30 PT. Need to lock: speaker roster, live demo flow, virtual booth link, swag counts + shipping, and A/V requirements. I put a checklist below.

Sarah (Events): Thanks — copying checklist. Proposed rehearsal: 2026-04-05 10:00 PT (30m). Can everyone make that? :calendar:

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Rehearsal OK. Quick Q: are we demoing against partner hardware on-site or via cloud marketplace images? We should confirm credentials and a fallback (hosted model) in case hardware flaky.

Elena - AcmeHW: We'll bring a single test unit + network switch. On-site plan: run live inferencing on device with Redwood dedicated connector. ETA for unit: 2026-04-10. We can provide a pre-provisioned service account and SSH key.

Marco (Partnerships): Perfect. Ravi — please prepare two demo paths: (A) hardware-attached low-latency demo, (B) hosted fallback using Redwood Hosted API. Keep both under 3 minutes each.

Sarah (Events): Run-of-show draft: 11:25 - booth open (virtual), 11:30 - intro (Marco, 2m), 11:32 - product overview (Ravi, 5m), 11:37 - live demo (Elena + Ravi, 8m), 11:45 - customer Q&A (5m), 11:50 - closing + CTA to marketplace listing (3m). Rehearsal will walk full flow.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Copy. For credentials: Elena please drop the SSH and service-account details in a secure doc. Also confirm port access and whether the device will be on a customer VLAN or public expo network.

Elena - AcmeHW: We'll use a partner VLAN (staged by venue). I'll upload the service account JSON to the shared secure folder and DM the key. Note: device needs 2x 110V outlets and one wired Ethernet; wifi is flaky at the venue.

Marco (Partnerships): Swag counts — we have 300 stickers, 150 t-shirts (assorted sizes), 50 demo-card dongles. Elena, partner swag to drop? We can handle booth fulfillment if you ship to this address: Redwood Events Ops, 420 Harbor Ln, San Mateo, CA 94404, arrive by 2026-04-08. Mark packages with "EdgeWorks — Marco".

Elena - AcmeHW: We'll ship 150 Acme-branded stickers + 50 pens. ETA 2026-04-07. Shipping label will include your address.

Sarah (Events): AV note: onsite tech will supply HDMI and power, but they require a run sheet and sample slide deck to pre-check resolution and fonts. Please drop final slides by 2026-04-01. Also provide a 16:9 PDF.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Slide owner: I'll own demo slides. Will upload a PDF + Keynote export to the shared folder by 2026-03-28. Also prepping a short shell script for quick local startup:

```bash
# startup demo on Acme device
ssh -i acme_demo_key user@192.168.10.5 'cd /opt/demo && ./start_demo.sh --model redwood-v1'
```

Marco (Partnerships): Nice. For the virtual booth: we need the marketplace link and a short 1-line CTA. Sarah — can you confirm the booth URL?

Sarah (Events): Booth URL: https://redwood.ai/edgeworks-booth-2026 (placeholder until marketing publishes). CTA suggestion: "Try Redwood inference on your data — free trial + partner credits." Keep to 90 chars.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): One more thing: fallback routing policy. If device latency > 120ms, switch to Hosted API. I'll add a tiny health-check script that flips a DNS flag; will demo both paths in rehearsal.

events-bot: Calendar event created: "EdgeWorks — Redwood + AcmeHW co-demo" on 2026-04-12 11:30 PT. Rehearsal scheduled 2026-04-05 10:00 PT.

Marco (Partnerships): Thanks all. Action items: Elena upload creds + confirm shipping (by 2026-03-30); Ravi upload slides + health-check script (by 2026-03-28); Sarah finalize booth URL + run rehearsals (by 2026-04-02). Ping me when items are done. :thumbsup:
